# Lab 6.21: Workload Identity Federation for GKE

## What We Are Going to Do
Give a Kubernetes pod access to a Cloud Storage bucket using Workload Identity Federation for GKE, with no keys.

## Steps

1. **Create an Autopilot cluster.** Workload Identity Federation is always on in Autopilot.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud container clusters create-auto wi-lab --region=us-central1
gcloud container clusters get-credentials wi-lab --region=us-central1</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Create a namespace and a Kubernetes service account.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">kubectl create namespace app
kubectl create serviceaccount app-ksa -n app</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Create a bucket and grant the KSA access directly.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">export PROJECT_NUMBER=$(gcloud projects describe $PROJECT_ID --format="value(projectNumber)")
gcloud storage buckets create gs://$PROJECT_ID-wi-lab --location=us-central1
echo "from GKE" | gcloud storage cp - gs://$PROJECT_ID-wi-lab/test.txt

gcloud storage buckets add-iam-policy-binding gs://$PROJECT_ID-wi-lab \
  --role=roles/storage.objectViewer \
  --member="principal://iam.googleapis.com/projects/$PROJECT_NUMBER/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/$PROJECT_ID.svc.id.goog/subject/ns/app/sa/app-ksa"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Run a test pod with that KSA.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">kubectl run wi-test -n app --rm -it \
  --image=google/cloud-sdk:slim \
  --overrides='{"spec":{"serviceAccountName":"app-ksa"}}' \
  -- gcloud storage cat gs://$PROJECT_ID-wi-lab/test.txt</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   It prints `from GKE`.

5. **Try with the default KSA.** Run the same pod without the override. Access is denied.

6. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud container clusters delete wi-lab --region=us-central1 --quiet
gcloud storage rm --recursive gs://$PROJECT_ID-wi-lab</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Keys in pods | None |
| Access granted to | One Kubernetes service account in one namespace |
| Default KSA | No access |
| Autopilot | Workload Identity Federation always enabled |
